howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会把 Resend 邮件适配器复制进 src/channels/、写入注册 import、装好固定版本依赖,再跑构建和注册测试;Resend 账号、域名与密钥需你手动配置并写入 .env。
howto.when: 当你要求把 Resend 邮件渠道接入项目时触发;若正处在 /setup 流程中,接好后再回到该流程继续。

say.text: 把这个 Resend 邮件适配器加到项目里
say.note: 会复制适配器、注册导入并跑构建和测试

say.text: 把我的 Resend API key 和 webhook 密钥写进 .env
say.note: 会提示你粘贴,已填的值不会覆盖

say.text: 把我的邮箱配成 owner,让 agent 给我发封问候邮件
say.note: 会建用户、授权、建 wiring 并发送

howto.what_en: Claude copies the Resend adapter into src/channels/, appends its registration import, installs pinned @resend/chat-sdk-adapter@0.1.1 and runs build plus registration test. Resend account, domain and key setup stays manual.
howto.when_en: Fires when you ask to add a Resend email channel to the project, or during the /setup flow when wiring email in.

say_en.text: Add the Resend email adapter to the project
say_en.note: Copies, registers, builds and tests it

say_en.text: Write my Resend API key and webhook secret into .env
Wire my email as owner and send me a hello
say_en.note: Creates the user, role, wiring and sends it
